recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser 3D platformer arcade game named Cipher Cottage Hop. Preserve the source mechanics: joystick movement, jump button, gravity, floating platform route, collectible score items worth +100, goal gate success, fall failure, restart, next level, and generated route feed. Rebuild presentation as a satirical Gravity-Falls-adjacent mystery cottage in a pastel dream / soft girl / cottagecore style. The focal actor is a pastel cipher scout with bow/cape silhouette. Platforms are soft quilt/moss slabs, collectibles are golden calm charms, and the goal is a pink cipher gate. Keep copy short, meme-toned, anti-anxiety, and mobile readable: “its giving solved,” “moss nap,” “no panic.” Use browser-native CSS/Three.js procedural art, animated background motifs, and touch-friendly portrait controls.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
- genre: 3D mobile portrait platformer / parkour arcade.
- objective: traverse generated floating platforms, collect optional tokens, and land on the goal platform/gate.
- input model: left virtual joystick for camera-relative movement, right jump button, menu buttons via native click/tap.
- core loop: start route, move and jump across slabs, collect +100 tokens, avoid falling, reach goal, retry or continue.
- fail/friction state: falling below the route triggers a failure/game-over screen; restart restores the same route.

## Protected Mechanics
- Three.js 3D scene, perspective camera follow, generated platform route, raycast floor landing, gravity/jump velocity, token pickup radius, +100 scoring, goal-triggered win, falling failure, restart/next/community route flows.

## Safe Presentation Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title/menu copy, actor silhouette/materials, platform/gate/token materials, procedural background/decor, route names, feedback toasts, fonts, palette, panels, mobile control styling, and non-blocking audio ambience.
